notes.title: Development Update: Progress, Fixes, and More!
notes.content:
[p]Hello to all Natural Elements Online adventurers[/p][p]We want to share with you some important developments in our magical open world. While there's still a long way to go, we're moving forward steadily and eagerly.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Recent News![/h2][p][b]Quest System Completed! The quest system is now fully functional. This will allow players to experience adventures, unlock unique challenges, and delve deeper into the lore of the Natural Elements Online world.[/b][/p][p][b]Multiplayer Testing Underway! We've begun the first multiplayer tests, allowing players to interact, collaborate, and explore the NAEL universe together. Feedback from these tests will help us improve the co-op experience before launch.[/b][/p][p][b]🔧 Improvements and Fixes: We're actively working on fixing reported bugs in key systems like skills, navigation, and progression. Each patch brings us closer to a more stable and fluid game.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45631587/5d6eea8a7874a4d7e5f8ed372de5aa045a141613.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Your support is key![/h2][p]If you haven't already, we invite you to add Natural Elements Online to your Steam wishlist. Not only will this keep you up to date with future updates, but it also helps us as developers a lot![/p][p][/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757570/natural_elements_online/"]Add to my Steam wishlist[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com//store_item_assets/steam/apps/3757570/e7a249c20e6318b0e5c5143bee4e0bd372fc62e7/header_spanish.jpg?t=1748050495"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3757570/Natural_Elements_Online?snr=2___"][b]Natural Elements Online[/b][/url][/p][p][/p][p]We're also building an active community where we share previews, sneak peeks, and answer questions. Join our official WhatsApp Channel![/p][p][/p][p]🔗 [url="https://chat.whatsapp.com/CgKM88yZyhyBUpBtIlWUrj"]WhatsApp Channel – Official Community[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for joining us at this important stage of development. There are still many challenges ahead, but the journey has already begun.[/p][p]See you in the world of Natural Elements Online![/p][p]—The Natural Elements Online Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Natural Elements Online is coming to Steam
notes.content:
Hello, community!

Today we’re thrilled to share a milestone that means a lot to us:
Natural Elements Online will officially be released on Steam.

After a long road of development, we’ve chosen Steam as the home for our elemental universe. Its vast reach, reliability, and development tools provide the perfect environment to deliver a solid, accessible, and global experience.

This marks a key step for the future of the game. Steam not only helps us reach more players, but also connects us with a passionate and active community that will grow with us every step of the way.

🎮 What’s next?
We’ll be sharing more details soon regarding launch timing, early access, and a few surprises we’ve been working on behind the scenes.

🌿🔥💧🌪 Thank you for being with us since the beginning. Your support has been essential in getting us to this point.

We keep moving forward — and now, with Steam!
